# Fincash

> > Fincash is a comprehensive financial information portal providing IFSC codes, MICR codes, and branch details for Indian banks including RTGS, NEFT, and UPI banking services.

The platform serves as a banking reference database, offering detailed branch locator services across India with extensive coverage of cooperative banks, nationalized banks, and regional branches in states like Maharashtra, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Gujarat.

## Key Topics

- IFSC Codes
- MICR Codes
- RTGS (Real Time Gross Settlement)
- NEFT (National Electronic Funds Transfer)
- UPI (Unified Payments Interface)
- Bank Branch Locator
- Abhyudaya Cooperative Bank Limited
- Allahabad Bank
- Ahmedabad Mercantile Cooperative Bank
- Maharashtra Banking
- Cooperative Banks
- Banking Codes and Information
- Branch Details
- Electronic Fund Transfer
